S25.05.needs: an image in Library (generated or uploaded)
S25.05.note: Chat image attachments open the same viewer (accessibility hint 'Opens full screen' in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/MessageBubble.tsx).
steps: Open the navigation drawer (the icon button labelled 'Open navigation drawer' in apps/mobile/src/shared/components/DrawerButton.tsx; its position on screen was not verified) and tap Library.
Tap any image tile in the Library grid.
Look for a full-screen black viewer that shows the image, with a row of icon buttons at the top and a Close (X) button at the top right.
Tap Close to return to the grid and compare with Expected: images open in a viewer.
S25.05.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > tap an image tile

S25.07.note: The in-app player's controls were not read in detail; the failure hint tells the user to long-press the video and choose Share.
steps: Open the navigation drawer and tap Library.
Tap a video file card in the Library grid.
Wait for the video player to open over the Library screen, then press play.
Check that the video plays inside the app and compare with Expected: video files play in an in-product player. If it fails, the alert 'Could not play the video' appears.
S25.07.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > tap a video file card

S25.14.needs: an image in Library, and a phone or touch screen for pinch and double-tap
S25.14.note: No on-screen zoom buttons exist; Expected says 'zoom controls', while the code offers pinch, double-tap, and screen-reader 'Zoom in' and 'Zoom out' actions (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ZoomableImage.tsx).
steps: Open the navigation drawer, tap Library, and tap an image tile to open the viewer.
Pinch two fingers apart on the image, then pinch them together.
Double-tap the image to zoom in, then double-tap again to zoom out.
Compare with Expected: viewers offer zoom. Zoom is by gesture only.
S25.14.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > tap an image tile

S25.25.note: No full-screen toggle was found: the image viewer always opens as a full-screen modal, and the only 'full screen' wording is the fallback label 'Full screen generated image' in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ImageFullScreen.tsx. I searched apps/mobile/src for 'full screen', 'fullscreen' and 'Full-screen' in the library, chat and file viewer folders.

S25.26.needs: a file in Library (an uploaded or generated file)
S25.26.note: No control named Download exists for Library files; for images, the viewer's 'Save image to Photos' saves to Photos instead of the original file.
steps: Open the navigation drawer and tap Library.
Long-press a file card or image tile in the grid to open the action menu.
Tap Share. The app downloads the file to the phone and opens the system share sheet.
Compare with Expected: the original file can be downloaded. In the share sheet, check the save options the phone provides.
S25.26.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > long-press a file > Share

S25.28.needs: a device, and a CSV file in Library
S25.28.note: The text-file selection path relies on the system selection menu and was not exercised; the visible Copy buttons exist only for CSV and table grids.
steps: Open the navigation drawer, tap Library, and tap a CSV file.
Tap a cell in the grid to select it.
Tap Copy cell, then paste into another app such as Notes.

Compare with Expected: copied content matches the selected cell. Plain text files also allow long-press selection of lines and the system Copy menu (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/artifact-viewers/TextFileView.tsx).
S25.28.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > tap a CSV file > tap a cell > Copy cell

labels.text: Open it in another app to read it.

S25.29.note: The Office-file routing is read from a code comment in DocumentFileView.tsx; the exact list of file types was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Open the navigation drawer, tap Library, and tap an Office document.
Look for the message 'Open it in another app to read it.' with a Share button.
Tap Share to open the system share sheet, which lists apps that can open the file.

Compare with Expected: the file opens in another app. The file viewer header also has a share icon labelled 'Share' plus the file name (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/artifact-viewers/FileViewerScreen.tsx).
S25.29.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > tap an Office file > Share

labels.text: Preview isn’t available for this file type.

S25.30.needs: a file in Library of a type with no in-app preview
S25.30.note: Only Share is offered; there is no separate Download or Open button. Which file types lack a preview depends on apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/artifact-viewers/viewerKind.ts, which was not traced type by type.
steps: Open the navigation drawer, tap Library, and tap a file type that has no preview.
Look for the message 'Preview isn’t available for this file type.' with a Share button.
Tap Share to hand the file to another app through the system share sheet.
Compare with Expected: the app says there is no preview and offers Share as the download or open path.
S25.30.where: Open navigation drawer > Library > tap a file the viewer cannot render
